description: Complete Royal Navy Sea King coded 18 standing in the paintball game zones at Mayhem, Abridge. Its fuselage was used to complete ex-Egyptian Sea King Mk.47 776 also on site. Last recorded present August 2025.

Ex-Egyptian Air Force Sea King, present as a nose section mated with the fuselage of Royal Navy ZA136. Last recorded present April 2017; the two Sea Kings on site are distinguished by 776 being the ex-Egyptian composite and ZA136 the ex-Royal Navy machine.
Ex-Army Air Corps Scout, previously ground instructional airframe 7898M/TAD043, used as a paintball prop at Mayhem. Last recorded present August 2025.
Ex-Royal Navy Wessex coded U, used as a paintball prop at Mayhem. Last recorded present August 2025.
Wears 31 Squadron markings and the code DJ; previously ground instructional airframe 9251M. Stands in the open at the Mayhem paintball site. Last recorded present August 2025.
Ex-Army Air Corps Lynx used as a paintball prop at Mayhem. Last recorded present April 2017; presence in 2026 not independently confirmed.
